originalTitle: Superstars and broken records: 2026 Emmy highlights
summary: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards were hosted by Law & Order star Mariska Hargitay at the Peacock Theatre in Los Angeles.
content:
The 79th Emmy awards were record-breaking and star-studded.

Welsh actor Matthew Rhys made history with wins in two lead actor categories for his work in Widow's Bay and The Beast in Me.

Watch the highlights from television's biggest night of the year here.

chineseTitle: 超级巨星和打破的记录：2026 年艾美奖亮点
chineseSummary: 第 78 届黄金时段艾美奖颁奖典礼由《法律与秩序》明星玛莉丝卡·哈吉塔在洛杉矶孔雀剧院主持。
chineseContent:
第79届艾美奖破纪录，众星云集。

威尔士演员马修·里斯凭借《寡妇湾》和《我体内的野兽》荣获两项男主角奖，创造了历史。
